## Programme

| Date | Focus |
|---|---|
| **24 December (Thursday)** | Arrival and check-in in the evening |
| **25 December (Friday)** | Getting started: R/RStudio, data types, importing data and tidy data |
| **26 December (Saturday)** | Describing data: summary statistics, tables, distributions and `ggplot2` |
| **27 December (Sunday)** | From sample to population: sampling, probability and confidence intervals |
| **28 December (Monday)** | Testing ideas: hypothesis tests, *t*-test, chi-square and ANOVA |
| **29 December (Tuesday)** | Relationships and reporting: correlation, regression and sharing results; closing ceremony around 9 PM |
| **30 December (Wednesday)** | Departure |

A typical learning day runs from **10:00 AM to 6:00 PM**, with hands-on practice, lunch and question breaks. Timings may be adjusted and confirmed with registered participants.

## Who should apply?

- Master’s, MPhil and PhD students in Social Science and Humanities
- Researchers and teachers who want practical data-analysis skills
- NGO and policy professionals working with survey data
- First-generation learners (five fully free seats)

## Instructor


### Dr. Ajay Kumar Koli

*Founder and Director, SARA Institute of Data Science*

Dr. Ajay Kumar Koli will teach all modules across the five days, building concepts progressively from one day to the next.

- **Areas:** Research methods, data analytics and R
- **Experience:** 10 years of teaching and research
- **Training:** 20+ research and data-science trainings

### International online guest speakers

International experts will join online for special talks. Speaker names, affiliations, talk titles and session timings will be announced soon.

## Venue & practical information

**Dr. Ambedkar Bhawan, Sonipat**  
The Ambedkar Educational Society, near Dayanand Hospital, Kakroi Road, Sonipat, Haryana 131001.

- From Sonipat railway station or bus stand, an e-rickshaw takes approximately 10 minutes.
- Bring a laptop and charger, one recent passport-size photograph, ID proof and warm clothes.
- A blanket is provided; bring an extra one if you feel cold.
- Participants should use their own internet connection during the stay.
- Food is vegetarian. Alcohol, smoking and tobacco are not allowed in the premises.
- Accommodation is simple, hostel-style shared dorms and washrooms, separate for men and women.
- Please contact SARA before registering if you have accessibility requirements or health needs to discuss.

**Arrival contact:** Mr. Raj Pal - 93063 42596 or 99917 73740  
**Questions from women:** Dr. Kiran Lata - 81680 60500

## Free seat application

Five seats are free for first-generation learners. To apply, email `sara.institute.info@gmail.com` by **22 November** with the subject line “Free seat: [your name]”. We will announce the selected learners on **25 November.**

#### In your email, please tell us:

- who you are, where you study or work, and your city
- why you need a free seat, and what you hope to do with R after the Winter School
- that you will reach the venue on **24 December** and attend all five days

#### Please note

- You must be a first-generation learner.
- You must not be receiving any other fellowship at the time of applying.
- Write in your own words, in 150 to 250 words. Emails written by AI, copied from others or sent as mass messages will be rejected.
- Send one email only. No documents are needed.
- A video call may be required before a free seat is confirmed.
- Priority goes to learners from marginalized communities and women.

**Contact:** `925 315 2024` · `sara.institute.info@gmail.com`
